title: kbtools.py ranks the wrong entry first for the needs query log and how long landing steps take
goal: kbtools.py NEED puts querylog.py first for query log and backlog.py first for how long landing steps take: a name of several words (querylog) matches the words of a need, and a word in a description that names no need (long in long research) does not outrank a command that answers it

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kbtools as k; e=lambda t,kind,a: {'tool':t,'kind':kind,'command':'x','answers':[a],'mcp':[],'summary':''}; c1=[e('querylog.py','tool','reads the store of questions asked'),e('kbmon.py','tool','shows the log of the query pane and its status'),e('redact.py','tool','removes secrets from a log'),e('other.py','tool','does other work')]; c2=[e('backlog.py','tool','lands items and prints how the landing steps of an item went'),e('kb-lookup','agent','Long research whose tool output would fill the caller context'),e('x.py','tool','unrelated')]+[e(f'skill-{i}','skill','runs a step and lands the work') for i in range(6)]; a=k.search('query log',c1)[0]['tool']; b=k.search('how long landing steps take',c2)[0]['tool']; print('planted catalogs, first for query log:',a,'| first for how long landing steps take:',b); sys.exit(0 if (a,b)==('querylog.py','backlog.py') else 1)

clauses.clause: kbtools.py NEED puts querylog.py first for query log and backlog.py first for how long landing steps take: a name of several words (querylog) matches the words of a need
